description: THE way to score a creator: get their COMPLETE-FOOTPRINT CreatorScore from a SINGLE handle or profile URL. A CreatorScore is ALWAYS the full cross-platform footprint — when a user gives you any one handle/URL and says 'score this creator', ALWAYS use this; NEVER offer to score just that one platform as an alternative (single-platform-only is not a product we sell). Give it ANY one of their accounts; it AUTO-DISCOVERS their OTHER accounts across platforms (from the bio's link-in-bio + Google-Search-verified matches, each with a confidence 0-1) — you do NOT need, and must NEVER ask the user for, their other handles. If a creator isn't in our index yet (vet_creator came back empty), that is EXACTLY when to call this. TWO STEPS: by default (confirm omitted/false) it PREVIEWS the discovered footprint — every account found with its profile URL + confidence, charging NOTHING — so you can show the user the URLs and confirm the RIGHT person before spending a credit. After they confirm, call again with confirm:true to score the WHOLE footprint as one creator and compute the official unified cross-platform score — ALL for EXACTLY 1 credit (the unified is included; it is NEVER charged again to 'merge'). Scoring runs in the background (~10–20 min); confirm returns a job_id to poll with check_score_job. NEVER offer to score just one platform (single-platform-only is not a product we sell). Use this whenever someone says 'vet / get the score for [creator]' and gives a single handle or profile.

confirm.description: Leave false/omit to PREVIEW the discovered footprint (URLs + verdicts, nothing charged). Set true — after the user has verified the accounts — to score the whole footprint for 1 credit.

handle.description: The seed handle, without a leading @.

include_accounts.description: Accounts from the preview's OFFERED list that the user has checked and confirmed are theirs. Only these join the verified footprint when scoring; anything not offered is ignored.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence for a discovered account (default 0.5).

platform.description: The platform of the ONE handle you're starting from.

name: score_creator_footprint
